instruction: Convert the receipt image OIP.jpg from /home/user into a PDF document. Save it as "invoice.pdf" in the Documents folder.

metadata.explanation: Task requires converting OIP.jpg to a PDF named 'invoice.pdf' in Documents folder. Evaluator checks: (1) file exists at /home/user/Documents/invoice.pdf, (2) has exactly 1 page, (3) file size > 10KB, (4) contains at least one image. The check_pdf_pages metric with verify_content=true ensures the PDF was properly created with image content.
